reviews.text: Rather small but great welcome and advice

A very professional and lovely team who are always happy to give the best advice!
It's now my go-to shop for my kitten ❤️

Fantastic team! I met them this morning, despite the challenging circumstances as they were experiencing technical difficulties. Despite the situation, I was truly impressed by their resilience, patience, and the energy they maintained throughout.

They took the time to inform customers, find solutions, and maintain a highly professional attitude, always with a smile. A dynamic and very friendly team, and you can tell they enjoy working together.

I will be a frequent customer of your store.

Thank you for the warm welcome at your store; the cashier was very friendly and helpful.

And thank you again for the kind gesture! 😻
Another store forgetting about exotic pets, damn it! It's such a shame!!! My chinchillas still won't have toys etc. from local shops.

A very good establishment for a shop in the city center.

The salespeople are friendly and helpful.
I was greeted by Pauline, who was very happy and smiling. She immediately gave me advice for my cat and answered my questions.
I left with what I came for and am very happy with my purchase, as is my cat!

I agree with the other comments!
I have two rabbits, and it was such a disappointment to arrive and find no section dedicated to exotic pets, not even a few bags of hay or anything. I find it quite disappointing. Why open a pet shop if an entire category of animals is ignored?
Fortunately, the staff is very pleasant.
staff who are of course very familiar with animals

Nothing for exotic pets, which is a shame :( and some small price display errors that lead to surprises at the checkout, which is a shame :/
Otherwise, the staff are very friendly!
A very good selection of products and the staff were very kind and helpful!

I usually like MaxiZoo, but this one doesn't have a small animal section? As a rabbit owner, I can't find what I need in a pinch at a food store because they only sell toxic products. I expect a bit more from a pet store.
